spec.name: Full Send Slots Cabinet
spec.description: An upright New Orange SMP slot machine with a charcoal cabinet, orange brass trim, three cream reels showing cherry, seven and orange symbols, an orange marquee and a right-side lever. Fits x/z 0–16 and y 0–29 for Minecraft item displays. Front faces negative Z; no coins or money piles.
